evidence: The change adds one test file and touches no production code, so it cannot regress existing behavior.

The failed-read test corrupts an import_map row, checks that ByID returns an error, removes the row, and checks that the next read succeeds. That covers the claim that a failed read is not remembered.

The goroutine test uses an error channel with capacity 16 for 8 senders, so no sender blocks. Each goroutine calls wg.Done on exit and the channel is closed only after wg.Wait returns, so the test has no deadlock or send-on-closed-channel path.

The helpers kinFixture, openSource, memoryOf, card and engramObservation, and the sqlite driver registration, are not defined in this diff. I assume they exist elsewhere in the package's tests; I cannot confirm that from the diff, and nothing in it contradicts it.
